notes: Fixes. A picture added from a file or with Ctrl+V is now fitted to the pages instead of being cut, and it no longer decides how tall the joined image is - a small picture used to chop a capture down to its own height, and a phone photo used to make the whole image huge. Take the tick out of Match heights to keep a picture at its full size. Chrome's own error pages (404 with no body, DNS or connection failures) can be captured again: no extension may run on them, so Full page and Visible area capture what is on screen and the editor says why.
